title: Perfume clubs: Forget virtual, fragrance brands take it IRL
summary: As fragrance communities gain traction on social media, grassroots clubs in the US, Europe and China are turning in-real-life (IRL) scent discovery into a social experience in its own right. Beauty brands are tapping into this trend to forge closer connections with fragrance enthusiasts, creators and experts offline.
